name: reachinbox-email-scheduler
description: Production-grade distributed email job scheduler with BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Google OAuth, Slack OAuth, and React dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm --workspace=@reachinbox/backend run dev" "npm --workspace=@reachinbox/backend run dev:worker" "npm --workspace=@reachinbox/frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=@reachinbox/backend run build && npm --workspace=@reachinbox/frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@reachinbox/backend run typecheck && npm --workspace=@reachinbox/frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@reachinbox/backend run test && npm --workspace=@reachinbox/frontend run test
